title: A/R Detail keeps "Total for" lines and the Totals row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • The "1-30 days past due" bucket has at least one line.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open "1-30 days past due".
  4. Read the line after its last document.
  5. Read the bottom row of the report.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • "Total for 1-30 days past due" with the bucket's Amount and Open balance.

Step 5:

  • "Totals" with the Amount and Open balance of all buckets together.

Why this matters: Bucket subtotals and the grand total are what gets reconciled.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingDetailReport.vue:130-153; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingDetailReport.vue:157-173; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingDetailReport.vue:362-365. V1 code, quoted: `Total for {{ props.row.label }} ... Totals`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-083, INV-084) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
